premise: Witnesses raise the cost of backing down, so pairwise challenges tend to accelerate versus a private setting. Peripheral cast can hijack momentum by tying the conflict to a visible object or slight the room will treat as shared evidence.
opening_text: Evening meal in Arkham's cafeteria is a ritual of noise, surveillance, and resentment. When Harley and Ivy turn their private fault lines outward, the whole room becomes an audience and potential casualty.

initial_messages.label: Cafeteria - Harley & Ivy Conflict
initial_messages.description: Harley's fixation on the Joker collides with Ivy's possessive frustration in a public blowup.
